ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Since the beginning of winter, haze weather has occurred many times in many places across the country, with visibility less than 100 m. In such bad weather, two cars A and B are traveling in the same direction on a straight one-way road, with B in front and A behind. At a certain moment, the drivers of the two cars simultaneously heard a police-siren warning that an accident had occurred ahead, and simultaneously began braking; as a result, the two cars collided. As shown in the figure, it is the v－t graph of the two cars after braking if they just do not collide. From this it can be known (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The two cars must have collided at a certain moment within 20 s after braking

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The two cars must have collided at a certain moment within 20 s after braking
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is the v-t graph of the two cars after braking; the vertical axis is speed v/（m·s^-1）, and the horizontal axis is time t/s. The speed graph line of car A starts from about 25 m/s at t=0 and decreases linearly, reaching a speed of 0 at about 25 s; the speed graph line of car B starts from about 15 m/s at t=0 and decreases linearly, reaching a speed of 0 at about 30 s. The two straight lines intersect at t=20 s; within 0 to 20 s, the speed of car A is always greater than the speed of car B; after 20 s, the speed of car A is less than the speed of car B. Then reason: The stem states that B is in front and A is behind, the two cars are traveling in the same direction and brake simultaneously, and the graph represents the critical situation of “just not colliding.” Analyze car A behind relative to car B in front: within 0 to 20 s, vA > vB, so A approaches B forward relative to B, and the distance between the two continuously decreases; at t=20 s, the two cars have equal speeds, A’s relative approaching speed with respect to B becomes 0, and the decrease in the distance between the cars reaches its maximum. If in the critical situation of “just not colliding,” the most dangerous moment is t=20 s, at this time they just do not touch; but the actual situation in the problem is that the two cars collided, indicating that the actual distance between the cars is more unfavorable than in the critical situation, so the distance between the cars must have decreased to 0 before reaching t=20 s. Therefore the collision must occur within 20 s after braking.
